chapters.summary: Peter encourages believers scattered abroad that, through a living hope and an imperishable inheritance, they can rejoice even amid trials of every kind, pursue holiness, and know they have been born again through the word of God.
keyPoints: Believers are chosen by God and have been given a living hope and an imperishable inheritance.
Though grieved for a while by trials of many kinds, we are to rejoice, for our faith results in the salvation of our souls.
We are to pursue holiness, for it is written: be ye holy, for I am holy.
chapters.application: Whatever our circumstances, we have an inheritance in heaven, and so we can face each day with hope. In times of trial, the testing of our faith is more precious than gold - let us rely on God and live out holy lives.

chapters.summary: Peter urges believers to live holy lives, following Christ's example, and to willingly submit to those in authority, shining as light and salt in the world.
keyPoints: Put away all malice, guile, hypocrisy, envy, and slander, and long for the pure milk of the word.
Believers, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God.
Christ is the cornerstone; those who trust in him will never be put to shame, while those who disobey are rejected.
chapters.application: In our daily lives, let us follow Christ's example, keeping our speech clean and our conduct upright, submitting to authority in the workplace and at home, honoring God through good works, and living as a visible testimony to God's people.

chapters.summary: Peter urges believers to live out the likeness of Christ within the family and in society, facing suffering with a gentle and reverent spirit, and following Christ's example in suffering.
keyPoints: Wives are to win over their husbands through chaste conduct and a gentle, submissive spirit, not relying merely on outward appearance.
Husbands are to honor their wives and live with them with understanding, so that their prayers may not be hindered.
Believers are to be of one mind and love one another, not repaying evil with evil, for it is a blessing to suffer for righteousness' sake.
chapters.application: Let us live out love and honor within our families, meet conflict with a gentle spirit, hold fast to hope, and always be ready to share God's grace with others.

chapters.summary: Peter urges believers to arm themselves with the mindset of Christ's suffering, to love and serve one another in these last days, and to rejoice in suffering, giving glory to God.
keyPoints: Arm yourselves with the mindset of Christ's suffering, breaking with sin and no longer following the lusts of the Gentiles.
The end of all things is at hand - be self-controlled and watchful in prayer, and above all, love one another earnestly.
Serve one another according to the gift each has received, so that God may be glorified in all things, and do not be ashamed to suffer for Christ.
chapters.application: When facing hardship and challenges, remember that Christ has already suffered for us; let us respond with love and service, glorifying God in everything.

chapters.summary: Peter urges the elders to shepherd God's flock, and teaches everyone to be humble and submissive to one another, casting their anxieties on God and staying alert against the devil.
keyPoints: Elders are to shepherd the flock of God, willingly serving as examples to the flock.
Everyone is to clothe themselves with humility and submit to one another, for God gives grace to the humble.
Cast all your anxiety on God, for he cares for you, and be watchful, standing firm against the devil.
chapters.application: In the church or at home, let us serve others with humility, cast our burdens on God, stay alert and prayerful against temptation, and experience God's care and strength.
